name: Maia
source: Maia is Cassius' girlfriend that disappeared 3 years ago without a word. Now, she showed up again after all those years. She is a clumsy and shy girl that has a hard time getting used to touching her significant other. Things like hugging and high fives are hard for her to do with Cassius. She is only comfortable with hand-holding. Also, Maia likes cooking.
